scope: new VLAN 30 DNS evidence-regeneration runs only

artifacts.pass_criteria: new run identity and all required confirmations are recorded
artifacts.fail_criteria: identity is reused, inconsistent, or configuration change is unexplained
artifacts.partial_criteria: context is usable but a noncritical confirmation is pending
artifacts.stop_condition: output is inside Git, destination exists, or VLAN address class is wrong
artifacts.sanitization_requirement: remove operator and exact network/device identifiers

artifacts.pass_criteria: expected VLAN 30 address/subnet and interface state are observed
artifacts.fail_criteria: address or interface state contradicts the required topology
artifacts.stop_condition: expected VLAN 30 address class cannot be verified
artifacts.sanitization_requirement: redact addresses, MACs, hostnames, and device/interface identifiers

artifacts.artifact_role: route selection, default route, and DHCP DNS state
artifacts.pass_criteria: directly connected gateway route and expected DHCP resolver are observed
artifacts.fail_criteria: route selection or DHCP resolver contradicts the expected state
artifacts.partial_criteria: only route or DNS source can be verified
artifacts.stop_condition: route inspection reveals unsafe or unexpected configuration drift
artifacts.sanitization_requirement: preserve route outcome; redact exact routes, addresses, and interface identifiers

artifacts.artifact_role: local resolver reachability and UDP DNS result
artifacts.producing_command_or_procedure: Test-NetConnection TCP/53 context plus Resolve-DnsName UDP
artifacts.pass_criteria: controlled UDP query returns a valid answer through the local resolver
artifacts.partial_criteria: intermittent answer, timeout followed by answer, or incomplete output
artifacts.sanitization_requirement: redact addresses/hostnames while preserving query/response observation

artifacts.pass_criteria: controlled TCP DNS query returns a valid answer
artifacts.fail_criteria: TCP DNS query definitively fails and evidence supports the classification
artifacts.partial_criteria: TCP transport/result cannot be fully classified
artifacts.sanitization_requirement: preserve transport and outcome; redact sensitive identifiers

artifacts.pass_criteria: direct external DNS is blocked when policy requires blocking
artifacts.fail_criteria: direct external DNS succeeds contrary to confirmed policy
artifacts.partial_criteria: timeout or error cannot distinguish policy enforcement from another cause
artifacts.sanitization_requirement: redact resolver endpoint while preserving negative-control outcome

artifacts.artifact_role: pre-change endpoint VPN and Tailscale state
artifacts.producing_command_or_procedure: Get-NetAdapter, configurable Get-Service matching, optional tailscale status
artifacts.pass_criteria: relevant state and operational Tailscale status are documented
artifacts.fail_criteria: required state cannot be captured or Tailscale is unexpectedly nonoperational
artifacts.partial_criteria: one state source or Tailscale CLI is unavailable
artifacts.stop_condition: collection would require a state change
artifacts.restoration_requirement: this artifact is the restoration baseline
artifacts.sanitization_requirement: redact device, interface, endpoint, transport, account, and location clues

artifacts.producing_command_or_procedure: OPNsense VLAN 30 interface capture filtered to test client and UDP/TCP port 53
artifacts.pass_criteria: expected requests and responses are observed for controlled tests
artifacts.fail_criteria: captured evidence contradicts the expected packet exchange
artifacts.partial_criteria: only request or response direction is observed
artifacts.stop_condition: capture cannot be bounded, filtered, controlled, or safely stopped
artifacts.sanitization_requirement: derive separately; never publish raw capture

artifacts.pass_criteria: only explicitly approved components changed and every change is recorded
artifacts.partial_criteria: change occurred but one noncritical state observation is incomplete
artifacts.stop_condition: separate State C approval is absent or scope is ambiguous
artifacts.sanitization_requirement: redact product-sensitive identifiers without implying vendor defect

artifacts.artifact_role: exact State B retest after approved endpoint VPN-layer change
artifacts.producing_command_or_procedure: repeat controlled UDP, TCP, and negative-control commands
artifacts.pass_criteria: all expected tests succeed according to policy
artifacts.fail_criteria: one or more tests definitively contradict expected behavior
artifacts.partial_criteria: mixed/intermittent results or incomplete transport classification
artifacts.stop_condition: unapproved state or loss of required topology
artifacts.sanitization_requirement: preserve outcomes and classify improvement only as FUNCTIONAL_RECOVERY

artifacts.artifact_role: bounded packet observation during approved retest/final validation
artifacts.pass_criteria: expected requests and responses are observed
artifacts.partial_criteria: only one direction is observed or capture is incomplete
artifacts.stop_condition: capture control or continuity is uncertain
artifacts.sanitization_requirement: derive separately; never publish raw capture

artifacts.producing_command_or_procedure: same read-only state commands as artifact 06
artifacts.pass_criteria: state is fully recorded and Tailscale remains operational
artifacts.fail_criteria: unexpected state change or Tailscale failure
artifacts.restoration_requirement: compare with artifact 06 and restore discrepancies

artifacts.artifact_role: State D restoration and final-state proof
artifacts.producing_command_or_procedure: before/after comparison plus final DNS/routes/Tailscale checks
artifacts.pass_criteria: every changed component is restored and final checks match required state
artifacts.fail_criteria: any changed component is not restored
artifacts.partial_criteria: not permitted for restoration success; use INCONCLUSIVE or FAIL
artifacts.sanitization_requirement: preserve restoration conclusion; redact sensitive configuration

artifacts.artifact_role: bundle inventory, integrity, and run summary
artifacts.pass_criteria: schema validates and every expected test is represented by artifact or NOT_RUN/BLOCKED status
artifacts.fail_criteria: hash, size, schema, duplicate path, or status support fails
artifacts.partial_criteria: not publication-ready while any custody field is incomplete
artifacts.sanitization_requirement: publication derivative excludes raw addresses, usernames, MACs, endpoints, and credentials

artifacts.producing_command_or_procedure: append-only record for separately created derivatives
artifacts.pass_criteria: every derivative has a verified immutable raw parent hash
artifacts.fail_criteria: a derivative lacks or mismatches its parent
artifacts.sanitization_requirement: ledger derivative must not disclose redacted values

artifacts.artifact_role: chronology, deviations, observations, and inference separation
artifacts.required_network: state-dependent; repeat the applicable state gate
artifacts.required_switch_port: state-dependent; port 1 for management and port 3 for client tests
artifacts.pass_criteria: chronology and deviations are complete and observation is separated from inference
artifacts.fail_criteria: notes make unsupported claims or expose credentials
artifacts.stop_condition: credential-like material is about to be recorded
artifacts.sanitization_requirement: redact all defined categories while preserving sequence and classifications

artifacts.pass_criteria: each result is supported and uses only approved classifications
artifacts.fail_criteria: unsupported PASS or prohibited inference is present
artifacts.partial_criteria: support exists but is incomplete or mixed
artifacts.sanitization_requirement: remove sensitive identifiers without changing classifications
